The yellow chevron is a stationary lift, not an ephemeral DLC Hyperspace icon. Fifth owner photo H61-E depicts the upper arrival area on a glowing pad as reported by player; roof photograph does not give verified native city map exit pixel.
owner_evidence.npc: Character visible next to device, consistent with Rust Syndicate grunt from published mission. Mission-complete/activation state not inferable solely from photo.

registration.false_correspondence_rejected: Direct close-up→W04 and close-up→W10 homographies contain repeated architectural patterns and project inconsistent city map locations (~(964,1539),~(698,1489)); rejected as geometrically inconsistent. Both close-up results must be chained through verified close-up→wide registration.
registration.precision_limit: Strong source-photo symbol identification and internally consistent permanent-landmark alignment. Approximate native source JPG coordinates, not one-pixel exact entrance geometry. Red player ring may be offset several source pixels from actual lift base.

how_to_find.start: Bleu Plaza fast-travel by Wild Zone 16
directions: Face the streets east/southeast from Bleu Plaza, toward Bleu Sector 3 and the area north of Aymlis Park/Wild Zone 12.
Find the short west-facing/west-southwestern building projection on Bleu Sector 3's southern edge, directly above the north side of Aymlis Park.
The lift is in the small building-side courtyard. Look for a tall glowing golden triple-chevron column by a paved corner; a Rust Syndicate character may be nearby if the mission is unfinished.
how_to_find.rooftop_exit_evidence: Owner-supplied fifth photo shows character standing on rooftop glowing pad after reported lift arrival. Independent map exit XY not yet obtained.
how_to_find.mission_gate: During Main Mission 20 Rust Syndicate storyline; if unfinished beat the guarding grunt to enable device
how_to_find.rooftop_arrival_visual: Broad stone-paved rooftop, Prism Tower prominent on right skyline, adjacent fountain/park below left, nearby optional Investigate prompt.

rooftop_survey_2026_11_22.photographic_observation: The player is standing on a luminous platform on a large flat rooftop with the Prism Tower in the right background and a landscaped green/fountain area below left. A separate Investigate prompt appears near a small purple object.
rooftop_survey_2026_11_22.evidence_relationship: Owner supplies the rooftop photo immediately after previously supplying ground-side mission 61 lift photos and explicitly identifies it as its roof. Visual confirms a rooftop/lift pad but a single image alone cannot independently prove transport source device identity or calculate rooftop image XY.
rooftop_survey_2026_11_22.minimap_note: Small minimap visible in top-left; NOT a full north-locked city map or precise original-image coordinate control. Do not derive a pixel-perfect roof point from it.
rooftop_survey_2026_11_22.cross_zone_photo_link_confidence: owner-reported route continuity; roof visual independently shows arrival platform; still needs optional north-up full map to georeference exact roof point
rooftop_survey_2026_11_22.do_not_misclassify: Investigate prompt is an interactable nearby object, not itself the lift exit; do not label its rewards, quest content or coordinates without verifying.
